verdict.rationale: Codex ships an official, well-documented CLI (npm install -g @openai/codex) with rich agentic capabilities: local repo editing, exec/non-interactive scripting, MCP support, subagents, image input, sandbox/permissions control, cloud task delegation, and shell completions — all first-party documented and confirmed via GitHub repo and docs. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarking specifically of CLI workflows (community evidence focuses mostly on model quality/UX rather than CLI mechanics) and some Linux-specific gaps noted by users.
